notes.title: SOPA - Tale of the Stolen Potato has a release date!
notes.notes:
Grab a bowl of SOPA and enter this magical world of adventures, frogs, and mischief on October 7th!! 👵🐸

Described by the Guardian, VICE, and IGN Japan as "a game that feels like playing a Pixar movie", and inspired by Miyazaki, Coco, and the Little Prince, SOPA is a heartwarming narrative adventure about the things that we pass along set in the distant fantastical lands of South America.


[previewyoutube="rzYpb3OnaUk;full"][/previewyoutube]


"It's like soup; warm and comforting, and exactly what I want" - The Indie Council.
